newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak ministry rejects all bids in T-bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Slovak ministry rejects all bids in T-bill auction.

text.p: The Slovak finance ministry on Wednesday rejected all of the 1.325 billion crowns worth of bids in an auction of its four-week Treasury bills, the central bank (NBS) said in a statement.
Ministry officials were not imediately available for comment on results of the auction.
In the last succesful auction of four-week T-bills on March 13, the ministry accepted bids worth 718 million crowns, out of total bids of 1,402 billion crowns.
The average yield in the auction was 13.277 percent.

The ministry uses its T-bills and state bonds as main tools to cover the state budget deficit, which totalled 3.45 billion crowns in the first quarter, up from a shortfall of 361.3 million crowns for the first two monhs of this year.
